nodes.title: SG-6.1 Data-driven NPC support from scene data
nodes.body:
Context: characterSchema (game/src/content/schema.ts) already holds id, name, position, scale, layer and idle/walk/interact animation refs. BootScene.createCharacter already spawns and animates sprites from scene.characters. Desired behavior: a scene author can add any NPC, with optional dialogue or interaction, in scene YAML only. Dangling character references are caught by validation, and clicking an NPC reports its interaction to React, with no code change. Why: future AI cycles must add characters without touching the engine.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene YAML character with an interaction block, When parseWorldContent('scene') runs, Then it validates and keeps the interaction data.
- Given a scene character whose id is not in world.characters, or whose interaction names an unknown dialogue, When validateWorld runs, Then it returns a descriptive error.
- Given a scene with several characters, When BootScene.create runs, Then one sprite is created per character at its position and each plays its idle animation.
- Given a character with an interaction, When its sprite is clicked, Then a characterClick event with its id and dialogue id is emitted.


## Scope
- In scope: characterSchema optional interaction field
- In scope: validateWorld checks for scene characters
- In scope: BootScene NPC click event
- In scope: characterClick bus event
- Out of scope: New art assets
- Out of scope: React dialogue UI changes
- Out of scope: Backend/API changes
- Out of scope: Pathfinding or NPC movement
- Preserve: Existing boy character behavior and animation resolution
- Preserve: Existing manifest and preload planning


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Zod schemas stay the single source of content validation
- Engine code must stay free of hardcoded character ids


## Definition of done
- All requirements have Act and Verify units complete
- Unit tests for the three slices pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Scene character schema accepts optional dialogue or interaction
nodes.body:
Context: characterSchema has no way to attach dialogue or interaction to an NPC. Desired behavior: add an optional interaction object { dialogue?: string, events: event[] } so NPCs can open a dialogue node or fire events from data. Expected result: characters without interaction still parse unchanged. Why: lets NPCs be authored purely in scene data.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a character with interaction { dialogue: 'greet' }, When sceneSchema parses it, Then the parsed character has interaction.dialogue 'greet' and events [].
- Given a character without interaction, When sceneSchema parses it, Then it passes and interaction is undefined.
- Given an interaction whose dialogue is a number, When parsed, Then a path-tagged error mentions characters.0.interaction.dialogue.


## Scope
- In scope: characterSchema in game/src/content/schema.ts
- In scope: CharacterSpec inferred type
- Out of scope: Loader reference validation
- Out of scope: Phaser wiring
- Preserve: Existing character fields and defaults


## Technical constraints
- Reuse eventSchema for events


## Definition of done
- Schema extended and type inferred


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · World validation rejects dangling scene character references
nodes.body:
Context: validateWorld checks speakers, objects and events but never inspects scene.characters. Desired behavior: every scene character id must exist in world.characters, its interaction.dialogue must be a dialogue id in that scene, and its interaction events go through checkEvents. Expected result: a bad NPC definition fails validation with a descriptive message. Why: data-only NPC additions stay safe.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene character id absent from world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown character: <id>'.
- Given interaction.dialogue naming a missing node, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown dialogue: <id>'.
- Given interaction events with an unknown flag, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown flag: <flag>'.
- Given a valid NPC, When validateWorld runs, Then it adds no errors.


## Scope
- In scope: validateWorld in game/src/content/loader.ts
- Out of scope: Manifest asset ref checks (planPreload already reports unknown refs)
- Preserve: Existing validateWorld error strings and the bedroom content validity


## Technical constraints
- Reuse checkEvents


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Validation implemented


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene spawns NPCs from scene data and reports their interaction
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.createCharacter spawns and animates sprites from scene.characters but a click only plays the interact animation. Desired behavior: add a characterClick event to PhaserToReactEvents and emit it from the sprite pointerdown handler when the spec has an interaction. Expected result: React can open the NPC dialogue without engine changes. Why: completes data-driven NPC support.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene.characters with two entries, When create runs, Then add.sprite is called twice with each position and each sprite plays its idle animation.
- Given a character with interaction.dialogue 'greet', When pointerdown fires, Then characterClick is emitted with { id, dialogue: 'greet' }.
- Given a character without interaction, When pointerdown fires, Then no characterClick is emitted and the interact animation still plays.


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
- In scope: frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts createCharacter
- Out of scope: React-side handling of characterClick
- Preserve: Existing interact-then-idle animation behavior
- Preserve: Sprite cleanup on SHUTDOWN


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Event typed and emitted; sprites spawn per scene character


## Clarifying questions
- None
